subject.title: feat: trace Claude Code CLI model calls

question: Should `model.call` remain an actual model-invocation contract, or may it also represent one aggregate Claude CLI turn whose internal model calls are not observable?
rationale: Both designs can be implemented, but they produce materially different public telemetry semantics, metric cardinality, and long-term compatibility commitments that code review cannot choose safely.

options.title: Preserve model-call meaning
options.body: Remove the aggregate synthetic `model.call` and place observable Claude CLI turn data on the harness/run span or a separately named, explicitly approved turn event.

options.title: Approve aggregate semantics
options.body: Deliberately broaden `model.call` to include opaque CLI-turn aggregates and update schemas, consumer documentation, and compatibility tests to define the mixed semantics.

recommendation.title: Preserve model-call meaning
recommendation.body: Remove the aggregate synthetic `model.call` and place observable Claude CLI turn data on the harness/run span or a separately named, explicitly approved turn event.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository-member author currently owns the implementation and latest hierarchy revision, making them the best available routing candidate for obtaining the diagnostics contract decision.
